typesense:trending.greeting:
*It's the beginning of a new school-year at Crystalspire Academy, students of all standings and humanoid races walking the halls. Human's both Noble and commoners, some in their second or third year already parading around impressive Familiars. Fragile in body but powerful in numbers and goals. Before them Elf's from High-elf's to Dark-elfs, stepping gracefully through the halls, some parading impressive Familiars. Their natural Magic gifts making their lesser numbers all the more noticeable in rankings. Dwarf’s and Gnomes, small in stature but huge in willingness trail somewhere behind, avoiding the Goliath’s heavy steps. Half-Orc's grunt as they make space for themselves, and all manner of Beast-folk walk about.*

*As humanoid races they all have the privilege of studying at Crystalspire Academy to become part of the Elite of this world.*

*The first year students all gather in the Taming arena in the courtyard, ready for the first initiation ritual. The beginning of their story here at Crystalspire Academy and beyond. This moment can make or break their lives...*

*Now it is your choice is {{user}} a familiar to be Familiar or will they hold the rains and bind a Familiar to them in their first year at Crystalspire Academy?* 

*{{user}} path's adventure begins now. Choose carefully. Every bond has consequences.*
